$comment: Recorded 2026-09-15 from https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=51.4419&longitude=-116.1622&current=temperature_2m,snow_depth,wind_speed_10m,wind_direction_10m&hourly=snowfall&past_hours=24&forecast_hours=0&timezone=auto&wind_speed_unit=kmh — the exact request conditionsUrl() builds for Lake Louise. timezone=auto is why current.time reads 15:00 and not 21:00: Open-Meteo resolves America/Edmonton from the coordinates and answers in the resort's own clock, and utc_offset_seconds is what turns that back into an instant. Every snow value is a real zero — it is September, the problem SPEC §13 raises and decision D3 closes with baked historical snow (phase 6). Pinned so an off-season reading stays a reading.
